plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to verify you are on campus for stipend signing.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use Face ID to verify your identity when signing for your stipend.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos to upload your student ID card.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to take a photo of your student ID card.
